versions.changelog:
Initial release of memory-layered: a structured six-layer memory architecture for AI agents.

- Introduces a persistent, multi-layer memory system: from dialogue history to extracted skills and learnings.
- Provides clear separation of memory by information density, including automated indexing, topic files, state tracking, and an experience archive.
- Includes REM (read-only pattern discovery), SWS (long-term consolidation), automated forgetting, and graceful degradation strategies.
- Aims for improved session-to-session continuity without overloading system prompts or context windows.
- Suited for agents needing persistent user/project memory, sharable file-based knowledge, and efficient knowledge management.
